legs.name: claude
legs.note: Host A native leg: an in-session Agent, never a CLI child. model/effort null = the named shipped preset's frontmatter pins; agent names one preset of the closed shipped list (the skill's SKILL.md rule 15, the plugin README).

legs.name: codex
legs.note: Host A codex leg: codex_wrapper.py with --sandbox read-only, stdin prompt transport; model = the recommended explicit codex ID (spec R-ROSTER; ONE codex leg) so the baseline does not depend on the operator's ~/.codex/config.toml; an explicit null override = the CLI's config default, frozen as null; every round binds review_web_authorized true under the owner's standing authorization, so this leg runs with codex's --search (R-REVIEW-WEB).

legs.name: google
legs.note: route null = the host chain (explicit pin, else agy if installed, else gemini, else skip and log — R-GOOGLE). Data values, not code constants (owner Q-W: Pro family + verifiable HIGH). gemini model = the v0.60.0 defaultModelConfigs.ts entry bound to ThinkingLevel.HIGH; not run live on this host. gemini takes no effort flag.
